errors.text_span: The largest proportion is labeled "Frustration," appearing in light blue at 25.1%
errors.evidence: In the figure, Frustration is the light blue/cyan slice at 25.1%, but it is not the largest proportion; Neutral is larger at 23.1% only if comparing the stated description? Actually the description misstates the relative ordering by saying Frustration is the largest proportion even though the chart shows Frustration at 25.1% and Neutral at 23.1%, so Frustration is indeed largest. No error here.
